notes.title: Patch notes 1.2.4
notes.content: UI Overhaul: Replaced nearly all of the old user interface with a new design and improved positioning of inventory on screen. Bigger inventory, pop-up-chest-inventory, split crafting into two categories: Tools & Structures, new icons and more. Fixed a bug where items equipped in hotbar disappear. Added the game options to the main menu, so you can adjust graphics and volume before starting the game. Fixed a bug where players couldn't craft items even though they have the required level and adjusted and balanced leveling due to very slow exp gain. Cooked Meat now regenerates more food. Due to game breaking bugs with armor equipment, we have removed armor temporarly until fixed (players can still use already crafted armor, but cannot craft new one). A new crafting system is in the works, since crafting is very slow and we're still figuring out how to fix the inventory bugs which only appear when playing online with friends. Players will now hunger and thirst 50% slower. Minor sound changes to ingame sfx.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.2.3
notes.content: Fixed Steam achievement "Stranded" not unlocking. Players can now unlock the Stranded achievement when spawning for the first time or respawning. Added beginner instructions for gameplay mechanics in options menu. Fixed bug where spamming e to collect items crashes game. Fixed tribe widget bugs.
